reuse: Existing web service; preserve its service ID, repo, branch, root directory, region, domains and current plan until confirmed. No automatic resource creation.

web.note: Preserve current On Commit setting. Do not push main or apply this draft. Existing panel build/start commands are not yet supplied.
web.runtimeValidation: Pending current production build and controlled Starter-like RSS/load measurement; heap limit is not total RSS.

notificationCron.note: Finite batch, not a continuous background-worker start command. Reuse an approved existing scheduler if available. Confirm queue throughput and cost. Future only; do not create a paid service.

retentionCron.note: Requires approved retention policy and dedicated operator OS/service identity. One run processes at most 100 records; alert and drain moreMayRemain batches. Future only; do not create a paid service.

database.reuse: Only an approved durable PostgreSQL database with application-specific database/roles and backups; never assume legacy DATABASE_URL is the application database.
database.connection: Choose and verify TLS route; preflight currently requires sslmode=verify-full. Render internal self-signed TLS cannot satisfy that mode.

launchMode.database: Absent; do not configure dummy connection strings or encryption keys
launchMode.contact: Existing telephone and WhatsApp only; no local application receipt/reference
